description: Link a test case, test run, or a run result (instance) to an Azure DevOps work item (requirement / user story / bug) by its URL — linked test cases are what give the work item its test coverage and traceability. Requires the Azure DevOps integration to be set up for the organization — otherwise a clear "set up Azure DevOps first" message is returned.

entity_id.description: Id of the case (ULID), run (ULID) or instance (number as string)

project_id.description: Project ID (ULID) the entity belongs to

work_item_url.description: The Azure DevOps work item URL, e.g. https://dev.azure.com/<organization>/<project>/_workitems/edit/165

name: tm_link_ado_issue
title: Link Azure DevOps Work Item
